rationale: The only implementation delta is ownership/lifetime management of SettingInfo: the vulnerable version heap-allocates it and never frees it, while the fixed version stores it on the stack and passes its address. The Logic section describes origin validation, permission checking, settings retrieval, object-list extraction, and object validation, all of which occur in both versions. It does not specify how SettingInfo is allocated or managed, nor does it describe the leak or its fix.
